name: Texas hold 'em
summary: Community-card poker where players make the best five-card hand from two private cards and five shared cards.
rules_text: Each player is dealt two private hole cards from a shuffled deck. Five community cards are revealed in stages: three as the flop, one as the turn, and one as the river. There are four betting rounds: after hole cards, after flop, after turn, and after river. On turn players may check, call, raise or fold clockwise. If all but one fold, that player wins the pot. Otherwise after final betting, remaining players showdown and make the best five-card poker hand using any combination of their two hole cards and the five community cards. Highest hand wins the pot; equal best hands split it.
